intelligence.essence: The only real mistake is the one you never wrote down and never learned from. Once you learn from a mistake — name it plainly, file it where the whole team can find it, and change your next decision because of it — it stops being a mistake and becomes a learning lesson. A mistake nobody recorded will repeat. A lesson everybody can read will not.
